finding.claim: With --url, allow_remote_refs is forced to True, disabling the base-path containment check for local file $refs. A remote schema can make the tool read arbitrary local JSON/YAML files via file:// refs and surface their contents in generated output or error text.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled schema served by the --url host, containing a $ref such as "file:///<path>". Precondition: victim runs datamodel-codegen --url <attacker URL>.
finding.sink: src/datamodel_code_generator/parser/jsonschema.py:11082-11085 (remote_object_cache.get_or_put -> _load_ref_data_from_path at 11002-11007 -> load_data_from_path): reads a local file outside the input directory.

finding.claim: Under default settings (allow_remote_refs=None), a local-file $ref resolving outside the input directory is permitted after only a deprecation warning, so an untrusted local schema can read files outside its directory.
finding.source: Schema file processed as input (e.g. from a cloned repo) containing a relative $ref with traversal to a JSON/YAML file outside the input directory. Precondition: default config, no --no-allow-remote-refs.
